Test Case Title: Verify successful login with valid email and password
Preconditions: User account exists in VWO with valid credentials
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to app.vwo.com/login
2. Enter valid registered email address in email field
3. Enter valid corresponding password in password field
4. Click Sign in button
Expected Result: User is redirected to VWO main dashboard. Session is established.

Test Case Title: Verify login fails with invalid password
Preconditions: User account exists in VWO with valid email
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to app.vwo.com/login
2. Enter valid registered email address
3. Enter incorrect password
4. Click Sign in button
Expected Result: Error message displayed: Invalid email or password. User remains on login page.

Test Case Title: Verify login fails with unregistered email
Preconditions: User does NOT have a VWO account
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to app.vwo.com/login
2. Enter email address not registered with VWO
3. Enter any password
4. Click Sign in button
Expected Result: Error message displayed: Invalid email or password. User remains on login page.
